Klasse ServerApi

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.server.serverApi.ServerApi
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
IServerApi
public class ServerApi extends Object implements IServerApi
Implements server-side actions: sending responses to clients, managing usernames, and broadcasting messages.
